name: JSW Steel Limited
remarksWeb: JSW Logistics Infrastructure Private Limited (JSW Logistics) has merged with JSW Techno Projects Management Ltd. (JSW Techno) vide NCLT Order dated November 6, 2019 and necessary applications under Regulation 10(5), 10(6) and 10(7) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011 have beennsubmitted to the exchange and the Target Company i.e. JSW Steel Limited (the Company). Further, JSW Techno has made necessary application for change of name in the demat account maintained with the Depository Participant (DP) of the erstwhile JSW Logistics, which is kept on hold due to lockdown and as a result, the erstwhile JSW Logistics is still appearing as Promoter Group in the shareholding pattern filed for the quarter June 30, 2020 by the Company.
